youtube.baslik: Can a small conductive loss wipe out a VEMP response? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Air-conducted sound reaches the otolith organs through the middle ear, so even a small conductive loss can shrink or abolish the air-conducted VEMP response; an absent response is then not read as a vestibular loss. With conductive loss, bone-conducted vibration is preferred, and the audiogram and tympanometry are always checked before VEMP.
